_comment: World Health Organization, World Malaria Report 2025: global map of malaria status in 2024, as attached to Taiwan CDC's 瘧疾預防用藥 page (瘧疾感染風險地圖). Digitised country by country from the image (registration of world.json onto the map, majority colour inside each country), then checked by eye on enlarged crops where borders are tight or countries are small. Countries not listed are white on the map (no malaria). Re-check against the image whenever CDC replaces it. Cabo Verde (certified 2024) and Maldives (certified 2015) are too small to read on the image and follow WHO's certification list; Syria reads as certified on the image — check against the original.

source.title: World Malaria Report 2025 — countries by malaria status, 2024

notes.MY: Malaysia has a significant number of indigenous malaria cases caused by Plasmodium knowlesi infection; zero indigenous cases of human Plasmodium species for the seventh consecutive year in 2024.
notes.SA: Zero indigenous cases for the fourth consecutive year in 2024.
notes.BT: Zero indigenous cases for the third consecutive year in 2024, ending the malaria epidemic.
